g.text: -publishUnavailableBatch(original: Snapshot, candidate: Snapshot, state: AppState) : String
+addContinuousBlock(state: Snapshot, name: String, start: LocalDateTime, end: LocalDateTime) : Snapshot
+addDailyBlocks(state: Snapshot, name: String, firstDate: LocalDate, lastDate: LocalDate, start: LocalTime, end: LocalTime) : Snapshot
+skip(state: Snapshot, commitmentId: int, date: LocalDate) : Snapshot
Equal startDate and endDate indicate a one-time commitment.
Both dates null indicate an unbounded weekly series.
